tour.name: French Polynesia 10-Day Private Island Tour: Tahiti, Moorea & Bora Bora
tour.subtitle: Ten days across the Society Islands with private guides: Tahiti's island circle and Papeete's market and roulottes, Moorea's bays, lagoon and pineapple valley, and the lagoon, motus and Mount Otemanu of Bora Bora, with ferries, inter-island flights and nine nights including overwater bungalows.

tour.overview:
The Society Islands are the classic image of the South Pacific: green volcanic peaks, lagoons of impossible colours and overwater bungalows. This private tour combines the three best-known islands: Tahiti, with its culture, waterfalls and capital; Moorea, a short ferry ride away, with its dramatic bays; and Bora Bora, the most famous lagoon in the world.

You have private guides and boats on each island, the ferry and inter-island flights, and nine nights in carefully chosen hotels, with free days to enjoy the water. It is ideal for a honeymoon.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: 10 days, 9 nights
• Start: Tahiti Faa’a airport
• End: Tahiti Faa’a airport (via Bora Bora)
• Type: private tour with local guides, private boats and vehicles, ferry and inter-island flights; 9 nights with breakfast
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability, hotels, flights and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: easy

WHAT YOU SEE
• Tahiti: the island circle and Papeete.
• Moorea: the lagoon and the Opunohu valley.
• Bora Bora: the lagoon, the motus and the island interior.

WHY THIS WORKS
The route follows the natural flow from Tahiti to Moorea and on to Bora Bora, with nights long enough on each island to relax.

WHO IT SUITS
Honeymooners, couples, families and anyone dreaming of the South Pacific.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
To add an atoll, extend with Rangiroa; for an authentic island, add Huahine.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
International flights arrive in Tahiti, often at night. Inter-island baggage allowances are 23 kilograms. The local currency is the CFP franc, pegged to the euro.

days.name: Arrival in Tahiti
days.description:
What to expect: a traditional welcome.

You are welcomed at Faa'a airport with a flower lei and taken to your hotel on the west coast.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
Any time – Airport welcome and transfer.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Many flights arrive late at night.

INCLUDED: airport transfer.
NOT INCLUDED: dinner.

Overnight: hotel in Tahiti.
Meals: none.

days.name: Tahiti circle island tour and the roulottes
days.description:
What to expect: the whole island and its flavours.

A private tour around Tahiti: Point Venus, the Arahoho blowhole, the Faarumai waterfalls, Teahupo'o, the Vaipahi gardens and the Marae Arahurahu, with lunch by the sea, and in the evening the Papeete market area and dinner at the roulottes.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
08:30 – Island tour.
12:00 – Lunch.
18:30 – Dinner at the roulottes.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Bring a rain jacket for the east coast.

INCLUDED: vehicle, guide, lunch, dinner.
NOT INCLUDED: drinks.

Overnight: hotel in Tahiti.
Meals: breakfast, lunch, dinner.

days.name: Ferry to Moorea
days.description:
What to expect: the short crossing and a free afternoon.

A private transfer takes you to the ferry to Moorea, about 30 to 45 minutes, and to your hotel on the lagoon. The afternoon is free to swim and snorkel.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
09:00 – Ferry to Moorea.
Afternoon – Free.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Hotels lend snorkelling equipment.

INCLUDED: transfers, ferry.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch, dinner.

Overnight: hotel in Moorea.
Meals: breakfast.

days.name: Moorea's lagoon by private boat
days.description:
What to expect: stingrays, reef sharks, coral and a motu picnic.

A private boat day: Cook's Bay and Opunohu Bay, snorkelling with stingrays and reef sharks, the coral gardens and a picnic on a motu.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
09:00 – Boat departure.
12:30 – Motu picnic.
14:30 – Back at your hotel.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Whales from July to October.

INCLUDED: boat, guide, picnic.
NOT INCLUDED: dinner.

Overnight: hotel in Moorea.
Meals: breakfast, lunch.

days.name: Moorea island tour
days.description:
What to expect: the Belvedere, the marae and the pineapple valley.

A private morning tour of the Opunohu valley, the marae, the Belvedere lookout, Magic Mountain and the juice factory, and a free afternoon.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
08:30 – Island tour.
12:30 – Free afternoon.

GOOD TO KNOW
• A Polynesian dinner show can be booked.

INCLUDED: vehicle, guide, tastings.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch, dinner.

Overnight: hotel in Moorea.
Meals: breakfast.

days.name: Fly to Bora Bora
days.description:
What to expect: the arrival by boat in the world’s most famous lagoon.

You fly to Bora Bora, about 45 minutes, with views of the lagoon from the plane. The airport is on a motu, and your hotel's boat takes you across the lagoon to your overwater bungalow.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
Morning – Flight to Bora Bora.
Afternoon – Free.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Sit on the left side of the plane for the best views.

INCLUDED: transfers, flight, boat transfer.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch, dinner.

Overnight: overwater bungalow in Bora Bora.
Meals: breakfast.

days.name: Bora Bora's lagoon by private boat
days.description:
What to expect: rays, sharks, coral and a motu lunch.

A private lagoon day: stingrays and blacktip reef sharks, the coral garden, the manta ray channel and a Polynesian lunch on a motu.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
09:00 – Boat departure.
12:30 – Motu lunch.
14:30 – Back at your hotel.

GOOD TO KNOW
• A sunset cruise can be added.

INCLUDED: boat, guide, lunch.
NOT INCLUDED: dinner.

Overnight: overwater bungalow in Bora Bora.
Meals: breakfast, lunch.

days.name: Bora Bora 4x4 island tour
days.description:
What to expect: the island interior and Matira Beach.

A private 4x4 morning: Vaitape, the viewpoints and WWII cannons, a marae, a pareo workshop and Matira Beach, then a free afternoon.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
08:30 – 4x4 tour.
12:30 – Free afternoon.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Matira Beach has restaurants.

INCLUDED: 4x4, guide.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch, dinner.

Overnight: hotel in Bora Bora.
Meals: breakfast.

days.name: A free day in Bora Bora
days.description:
What to expect: time to enjoy the lagoon.

A free day to swim, snorkel, paddle or relax. Diving, a jet-ski tour, a helicopter flight or a spa can be arranged.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
All day – Free.

GOOD TO KNOW
• A Polynesian dinner on the beach can be booked.

INCLUDED: —
NOT INCLUDED: activities, meals.

Overnight: hotel in Bora Bora.
Meals: breakfast.

days.name: Departure
days.description:
What to expect: the flight back to Tahiti and onward.

Your hotel boat takes you to the airport for the flight to Tahiti, connecting with your international flight.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
As needed – Boat and flight to Tahiti.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Allow at least 3 hours between flights in Papeete.

INCLUDED: transfers, flight.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch.

Overnight: none.
Meals: breakfast.

stops.name: Bora Bora
stops.description: A last look at the lagoon.

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose a date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability, hotels and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only when the tour is confirmed.

faq.question: Are the inter-island flights included?
faq.answer: Yes, with Air Tahiti, plus the ferry to Moorea.

faq.question: Is an overwater bungalow included?
faq.answer: Yes, 2 nights in Bora Bora; it can be extended to all 4 nights.

faq.question: What kind of hotels are used?
faq.answer: Comfortable 4- and 5-star resorts; we suggest options at different budgets.

faq.question: Is it suitable for a honeymoon?
faq.answer: Perfectly. Tell us and we will add honeymoon touches.

faq.question: Is it suitable for children?
faq.answer: Yes. Many resorts welcome families; we choose kid-friendly options.

faq.question: Is it suitable for people with limited mobility?
faq.answer: Partly; boats require some agility. Tell us your needs.

faq.question: Can we add Rangiroa or Huahine?
faq.answer: Yes, as extensions with extra flights.

faq.question: What currency is used?
faq.answer: The CFP franc, pegged to the euro; cards are widely accepted.

faq.question: What should we wear?
faq.answer: Light clothes, swimwear, a hat, sunglasses and reef-safe sun cream.

faq.question: What is the best time of year?
faq.answer: May to October, the drier and cooler season. Humpback whales visit from July to October.

faq.question: Should we tip?
faq.answer: Tipping is not customary in French Polynesia and is never expected, but a small gesture for excellent service is always appreciated.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour starts. Flights and resorts may have stricter terms; we explain them when we confirm. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
